description.zh:
是否删除全部自定义标签，仅当`tag_keys`为空时生效。取值范围：

- `true`: 删除全部标签。
- `false`: 不删除全部标签。
description.en:
Specifies whether to delete all custom tags. This parameter takes effect only when `tag_keys` is empty. Valid values:

- `true`: Delete all tags.
- `false`: Do not delete all tags.
The region ID of the resource.

description.zh: 资源ID列表。最多支持添加50个资源ID。
description.en: The list of resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs.

description.zh: 资源的标签键列表。最多支持添加20个资源的标签键。
description.en: The list of tag keys for the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-ids c1a7bb282fc0d48b593000 --resource-type CLUSTER --tag-keys TestKey1 --all true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cs DELETE /tags --region cn-hangzhou --all true --region_id 'cn-hangzhou' --resource_type CLUSTER --resource_ids '["c1a7bb282fc0d48b593000"]' --tag_keys '["TestKey1"]' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
